Container.Name: mcp-arr
Container.Overview: MCP server for the *arr media stack (Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr/Prowlarr) — exposes them as MCP tools over streamable-HTTP for AI agents. Native HTTP transport, no wrapper needed. Pinned to 1.7.3 — 1.6.5 accepted TCP connections but never answered HTTP requests. Check the project's releases before moving off this pin. Set ExtraParams below to bind only to this server's Tailscale IP instead of all interfaces (e.g. -p 100.101.102.103:8907:8907) — replace with your own Tailscale IP.

Config.Name: SONARR_URL
Config.Description: Sonarr base URL (leave blank if not running Sonarr)

Config.Name: SONARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Sonarr → Settings → General → Security → API Key

Config.Name: RADARR_URL
Config.Description: Radarr base URL (leave blank if not running Radarr)

Config.Name: RADARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Radarr → Settings → General → Security → API Key
